items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And the bass player, Sylvester. [INTERVIEWEE] But he played a while there with us.

ctx.x: Austin, yeah, yeah. And then Handy. What was he playing? Bass. His brother was playing bass. Eddie Hand, no Eddie Hand is the saxophone player. You see John Handy is the bass player. John Handy is the bass player, yeah.
No, John Handy played saxophone and clarinet. Yeah, that's right. And the bass player, Sylvester.

But he played a while there with us. And also Duke Deconje played the piano. And Butler rap. Gaillet. Gaillet, yeah. He played the guitar. And I played the drum. Duke Deconje? Duke Deconje, yeah. He played the piano with us. Does he play any other instruments? No, he just played none of the piano. He got killed. You know he had a shoe shop there on Ramport near Common and he went out with this this fellow played the piano, Richardson they called him. Herbert Richardson, you know Herbert Richardson? No?
